answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that only unlocks after a history of useful work, so a falcon-fast flood of fake accounts still costs real capital per identity. Reputation then accrues like a comet's tail — visible, slow to build, tied to verified transactions, not self-declared claims. Only identities reaching the zenith of consistent, attested performance earn access to high-value jobs, so an attacker must pay full price per fake instead of minting thousands for free.
